Clear guidance for every professional message

A focused system for writing, designing and reviewing work for real estate professionals.

Teal leads. Blue supports. The message stays human.

Use this page to make confident choices without adding new brand elements.

Foundation

Help professionals move their business forward

We make expertise feel supported. Every message should show a useful business outcome and make the next step feel clear.

Know the audience

Speak to people who manage growth, visibility, leads, portfolios and digital processes.

Lead with value

Start with the result for the professional. Explain the product only after the benefit is understood.

Earn confidence

Use concrete language, believable proof and one clear action. Never overpromise.

Who we design for

Choose the business need before choosing the message.

Agencies

Qualified leads, stronger visibility, better marketing and business growth.

Developers

Early buyer reach, project marketing, reporting and support throughout sales.

Property managers

Tenant acquisition, fewer vacancies, digital rental and efficient operations.

Finance providers

Relevant financing leads and visibility at the right moment.

Institutional companies

Portfolio marketing, market insight and scalable digital solutions.

Service providers

Professional reach, awareness, partnerships and lead generation.

Voice

Professional and close to the people doing the work

We sound capable, collaborative, approachable, engaged and supportive. In German we always address business audiences with Sie.

Approved claim patternMehr Möglichkeiten. Mehr Erfolg. Mehr für Sie.

How it should feel

A trusted partner who understands the business, respects the reader and makes progress feel possible.

Use direct sentences and familiar words.

Connect each feature to a business result.

Avoid pressure, hype and vague promises.

Clear writing in practice

Use this

Erreichen Sie mehr Eigentümer und gewinnen Sie passende Mandate.

The outcome is specific and the tone is respectful.

Avoid this

Mit unserer Lösung revolutionieren Sie sofort Ihr gesamtes Geschäft.

The promise is inflated and the language is distant.

Identity

One recognisable system with disciplined emphasis

The ImmoScout24 master brand stays visible. Teal is the leading brand colour. Blue is the Professionals accent. Sand creates calm space.

Logo use

Place the supplied artwork directly on the composition. Never add a backplate.

Colour roles

Give each colour one job. Teal leads the brand. Blue draws attention to a selected detail.

Teal#3DF5DC
Professionals blue#24E3FF
Sand#FBF8F6
Charcoal#333333
White#FFFFFF
Use this

Charcoal text on teal

Strong contrast and consistent brand recognition.

Avoid this

Never place white text on teal

White is reserved for charcoal surfaces and photography with proven contrast.

Typography

Make It Better is the only typeface in the product. Extra Bold belongs to the main page heading only.

Clear value for professionals

Use Bold to organise sections and Regular for reading. Keep every heading in natural sentence case.

Main headingExtra Bold once per page
Section headingsBold with clear spacing
Body textRegular with generous line spacing
Imagery

Real expertise in believable moments

Show professionals at work in natural settings. Choose warm light, calm backgrounds and enough space for the message.

What makes this work

A genuine interaction with relevant tools.

Warm soft light and restrained contrast.

Clear space for copy without covering a face.

Crop with intention

Protect the person first. The message uses the remaining space.

Keep the subject and useful space
Avoid a tight and accidental crop
Layouts

One message with room to breathe

Build every layout from the same small set of parts: one headline, one supporting thought, one action, one logo and optionally one image or one approved highlighter.

Use clear space

Let the hierarchy lead the eye from value to proof to action.

Avoid visual competition

Do not crowd several messages, accents and actions into one view.

Paid social

Benefit first. One focal image. One action. Respect every platform safe area.

Landing pages

Move from promise to proof to service and finish with the same action.

Email

Use a calm reading width, one main action and a clear benefit near the start.

Review

Check the work before it leaves the Studio

Automation applies the rules. A person still confirms that the message, image and context are right.

Human approval is required

Stop the export when a source is unclear, a claim lacks proof, an image licence is uncertain or the layout weakens the message.

Make It Better is used everywhere.
Only the main page heading uses Extra Bold.
Teal leads and blue supports one selected detail.
Text on teal is always charcoal.
Writing uses natural sentence case and no decorative capitals.
The approved logo appears without a backplate.
